WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT)),0) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT)),0) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT)),0) CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_DCUSTOMER WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_DCUSTOMER WHERE H <> 'D'

)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_tgt
, CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_src
,CAST(CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_src
, CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CRLIMIT_tgt
, CARD_SUPP_PERM_CSHLIMIT_tgt
, CARD_SUPP_TEMP_CRLIMIT_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','')
